notes.title: Quest 3 Visual Enhancements
notes.content:
INVERSE v0.68 introduces visual enhancements and lighting for the Quest 3. 

We also implemented a new pistol reload system that will make the Extermination phase feel even more intense as you fight for your life. 

[url=https://massvr.com/inverse-update-0-68/]Full release notes can be found here.[/url]

notes.title: Swarm Update
notes.content:
INVERSE v0.65 introduces the Swarm: a hive mind of Skitters, a "small" arachnid-type Nul, that latch onto and attack Agent players. Skitters have swarm-intelligence and hatch during the Extermination phase of the match. As they find their prey, Skitters jump and attack, latching onto an Agent's arms and preventing them from picking up and using objects. Agents can squash Skitters or shoot them from a distance, but must not get too distracted to still complete their mission and eliminate the Nul. 

This update also sees the introduction of a new sprint stamina system; Agents can now escape a terrifying chase by tapping the sprint button. But once their stamina meter depletes, Agents won't be able to sprint again until thet catch their breath and their meter refills. 

[url=https://massvr.com/inverse-update-0-65/]Additional release notes can be found here.
[/url]
